description: Complete Phase 5: Professor Web Dashboard, iOS Auth/WebSocket integration, production JWT config, Apple/Google token verification, integration tests

stories.title: Production JWT Configuration
stories.user_story: As a deployer, I want JWT secret/configurable via env var so I don't modify code
acceptance_criteria: BIZSIMAI_JWT_SECRET env var required, error if missing
BIZSIMAI_JWT_EXPIRY_HOURS env var (default 24)
BIZSIMAI_CORS_ORIGINS env var (default *)
BIZSIMAI_HOST env var (default localhost)
BIZSIMAI_PORT env var (default 8000)
Health check reflects config values
tasks: Update auth.py to read JWT_SECRET from os.environ.get('BIZSIMAI_JWT_SECRET') with required validation
Update auth.py to read JWT_EXPIRY_HOURS from os.environ.get('BIZSIMAI_JWT_EXPIRY_HOURS', '24')
Update main.py to read CORS_ORIGINS, HOST, PORT from env vars
Update health check to return config values
Run existing tests to ensure nothing breaks
Update IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and progress.txt
stories.notes: COMPLETED: Production JWT config + Apple/Google JWKS verification

stories.title: Apple/Google ID Token Verification
stories.user_story: As a student using Apple/Google Sign In, I want my identity token verified against provider JWKS
acceptance_criteria: Apple ID token verified against https://appleid.apple.com/auth/keys
Google ID token verified against https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/certs
Token payload validated (issuer, audience, expiry)
JWKS keys cached with 6-hour TTL
Returns same token format as password login
tasks: Create backend/auth/providers.py with AppleIDVerifier and GoogleIDVerifier classes
Add JWKS caching (dict with expiry timestamp)
Update routers/auth.py to call provider verifiers
Add test cases for Apple and Google token verification
Update IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and progress.txt
stories.notes: COMPLETED: Production JWT config + Apple/Google JWKS verification

stories.title: iOS Auth Integration
stories.user_story: As an iOS user, I want the app to authenticate with backend and store tokens in Keychain
acceptance_criteria: AuthService.swift for login/logout/token management
Token stored in Keychain (not UserDefaults)
Token auto-attached to all NetworkService requests
Token refresh handled transparently
Logout clears Keychain token
tasks: Create TokenStorage.swift with Keychain read/write/get/delete
Create AuthService.swift with login, register, logout, refresh methods
Update NetworkService.swift to attach Authorization header from TokenStorage
Update SettingsView or add AuthView for login UI
Update SyncService.swift to use AuthService for auth state
Build and verify no compilation errors

stories.title: iOS WebSocket Integration
stories.user_story: As a student in an active session, I want live updates from backend via WebSocket
acceptance_criteria: WebSocketService.swift using URLSessionWebSocketTask
Auto-reconnect on disconnect (max 3 attempts)
UI updates on round_complete or leaderboard_update
Connection status indicator
Graceful fallback to polling
tasks: Create WebSocketService.swift with connect, disconnect, send, ping/pong
Add message type enum for server-to-client messages
Update SyncService.swift to use WebSocketService for live updates
Add connection status to BackendState.swift
Add status indicator to relevant views
Build and verify no compilation errors

Add JS for session management actions (create, start, advance, end)
Test all pages render correctly

Student register creates account via backend /api/auth/register

When no token exists, shows LoginView sheet with medium detent
When authenticated, shows Welcome back message with user's name
Logout button appears when authenticated
